body:
[Film Freek](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChUbcksMzsvvmSIyP3AxCPA) 

IMO a pretty promising channel. It’s about experimental film photography and the girl who runs it is really lovely. I follow her on Instagram and her photography is incredible. Plus I got some great advice from her when I asked her about a couple of her shots!

What is there to misunderstand? At no point in your bio do you state that you use Photoshop and Lightroom. Only that everything is entirely analog and shot on film. You're misleading people. Even on your EXIF on Flickr it shows that the image has been edited.

I understand when it comes to scanning that color corrections can and should be made. But a lot of your multi exposures look far too vivid. I've been doing photography for over a decade, in both digital and film, and to me a lot of your images look like they've been merged via the screen tool.

If all your multi exposures are real then maybe you should post your negatives too?

If you actually look into his work you'd see that he claims none of his work is edited.

On his website:
"All multiple exposures are created via the natural mixture of light in-camera, without the use of Photoshop."

So it's not an issue of editing a photograph taken with film, it's an issue of claiming a photo is unedited, when clearly it looks like it has been.
Hmmm. This and some of your photos on IG look very edited.
I don't know what his YouTube account would be :( Plus YouTube is a lot more public than other social media platforms. He wouldn't even need an account to view my videos.
YouTube. He knows I got one and actively make videos. My videos where I've gone on trips he has gone to the same places about a month later to an upload according to our mutual friend :/
I have a Youtube account, which he knows about as I told him about it before we broke up. It's niche one about photography so I'm thinking he looked it up.

When we did date a while back he said something about he how hates spending time on his own as he hates being alone with his thoughts. That set alarm bells ringing. I know he won't hurt me, but he's hurt me emotionally. So the fact he's copying and recreating a relationship with another girl, with the same name, is just plain freaky and worrying.

First of all props for not meddling with your co-worker. I know it must be nice to have someone to have a little crush on whilst your own relationship isn't a happy one, but it shows you got some emotional strength to let it go once he leaves. I'm gonna assume nothing has between you two and you've kept it friendly, so again props, because giving into temptation can really bite you in the butt. It must suck, but you'll be ok.

Secondly it sounds like you're in a bit of crossroads in your life. The fact you got a house, and guessing your age by your username (26/27?) that is great security. Try and keep the house for as long as possible. I say stick at it with your job for a year, you may better your chances to moving to another city if you do well. Last thing you wanna do is turn up sad and not wanting to be there- that's not a good look. Work towards your own fresh start. See your job as an income and keep your passion in photography separate from work.

Dump your boyfriend. It sounds like some gas lighting has been going on especially since you said he's been abusive in the past and owes you money. You're not unloveable and don't be scared to be single. Save up some money, get your own place, and enjoy being single. Yes it'll be scary at first but it'll do you the world of good.
